entities.name: Query protein (323 aa)
observations: Exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt B9DY04 and A5N4E1, both annotated as beta-ketoacyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] synthase III.
Predicted molecular weight is 35,018.24 Da; theoretical pI is 5.445; estimated charge at pH 7 is -3.46.
Sequence-derived instability index is 30.449 and GRAVY is 0.187.
The protein is inferred to be cytoplasmic and homodimeric based on the exact reviewed reference annotation.

entities.name: B9DY04
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Clostridium kluyveri annotated as beta-ketoacyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] synthase III.
Catalyzes the first fatty-acid-synthesis condensation: malonyl-ACP plus acetyl-CoA yields 3-oxobutanoyl-ACP, CO2, and CoA.
Has EC number 2.3.1.180 and Rhea reaction RHEA:12080.
Reference features include active-site positions 112, 249, and 279 and an ACP-binding region at residues 250-254.

entities.name: RHEA:12080
observations: Malonyl-ACP plus acetyl-CoA undergoes condensation to form 3-oxobutanoyl-ACP, CO2, and CoA.
This is the initiating condensation reaction of bacterial fatty acid biosynthesis catalyzed by beta-ketoacyl-ACP synthase III.

entities.name: Fatty acid biosynthesis
observations: The query protein is annotated as participating in lipid metabolism and fatty acid biosynthesis.
The enzyme may influence branched-chain versus straight-chain fatty-acid production through substrate specificity.
